usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/seedance/i2v with JSON body {prompt, urls[]} (image-to-video; urls is required, 1-12 public image/video reference URLs)
usage.outputShape: Async job: body.jobId (poll a status endpoint), body.status ("pending"), body.success, body.type. The finished video URL is delivered out-of-band/on poll, not in this initial response.
quirks: Price is $20.00 (payment.accepts amount=20000000 = 20 USDC, 6 decimals on Base eip155:8453) — exceeds the $6 QA cap, so it was NOT paid/tested.
Task summary CALL url (https://api.xona-agent.com/video/seedance-pro) is WRONG; the real endpoint per spec/probe/payTo is https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/seedance/i2v.
This is IMAGE-to-video: 'urls' (>=1 public image/video reference URL) is REQUIRED alongside 'prompt'; a prompt-only call will fail.
Returns an async job {success, jobId, status:'pending', type} — you must poll for the finished video; the result is not in the initial response.
Provider is StableStudio (stablestudio.dev) — same origin served by the agentcash/stablestudio MCP, which may be a cheaper/native way to call it.
usage.guide: This is ByteDance Seedance 2 Pro premium image-to-video, served by StableStudio. Call POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/seedance/i2v with a required 'prompt' string and a required 'urls' array of 1-12 public image/video reference URLs; poll the returned jobId for the finished video. Costs $20 USDC; not verified here because it exceeds the QA $6 cap.
